title: VTC Events — Guests — Register — payload
description: A guest — a party who is not a member — registers for an event that admits guests, or changes their registration. The reply is their receipt. The outer document members are owned by the framework — SPEC §6.3.

status.description: What the guest says; the community decides pending or waitlisted.

codeOfConductAcknowledged.description: The `sha256` of the code of conduct the guest acknowledges (VTI-EVT-035).

linkCode.description: Under `invited`: the code of an invitation link made for guests (VTI-EVT-107, 151).

Response.title: VTC Events — Guests — Register — response payload
Response.description: The success response to a vtc/events/guests/register/0.1 request. Carried in a Trust Task document whose type is https://trusttasks.org/spec/vtc/events/guests/register/0.1#response.

wasCreated.description: True when this request created the registration; false when it changed one the guest held.
